scene.prompt: Turn [image 1], a rough 3D blockout, into a photorealistic photograph with the same camera, composition and landforms: pale limestone sea-cliffs above surf, a small port town of stone houses with terracotta roofs beyond, Hellenistic Greece. Replace every smooth placeholder shape with real rock, scrub, stone and roof tile. Winter day under low grey overcast: soft flat light, no sun, no hard shadows, cloud low on the hills. [image 2] is a reference board: copy its messenger, pouch and sundial exactly. Cut into the cliff face above the surf, one narrow road shelf runs along the coast, just wide enough for two carts to pass going opposite ways. On the upper shelf one messenger (broad felt hat, ochre tunic, pouch at hip) jogs toward the town; on the lower shelf a second messenger dressed the same jogs away from it. On the headland above, the board's weathered stone sundial, casting no shadow. Deep focus, all sharp. No other people. Nothing modern.
